title: Glowing diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e8ff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#5bc8ff' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a5a99' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gemLeft' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e0f8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7dd8ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gemRight' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bdf0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4ab8f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gemTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f0fcff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9ae4ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gemFacet' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d4f4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5ec8f5'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Sparkle rays -->
  <g stroke='#c8f0ff' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'>
    <line x1='50' y1='2' x2='50' y2='10'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='94' x2='50' y2='86'/>
    <line x1='2' y1='52' x2='10' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='90' y1='52' x2='98' y2='52'/>
    <line x1='16' y1='18' x2='22' y2='24'/>
    <line x1='78' y1='80' x2='84' y2='86'/>
    <line x1='84' y1='18' x2='78' y2='24'/>
    <line x1='22' y1='80' x2='16' y2='86'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Diamond body -->
  <g>
    <!-- Crown top facet -->
    <polygon points='50,16 70,38 50,34 30,38' fill='url(#gemTop)'/>

    <!-- Crown left facet -->
    <polygon points='50,16 30,38 24,40 26,52 50,50' fill='url(#gemLeft)'/>

    <!-- Crown right facet -->
    <polygon points='50,16 70,38 76,40 74,52 50,50' fill='url(#gemRight)'/>

    <!-- Pavilion left facet -->
    <polygon points='24,40 26,52 50,50 50,88 20,56' fill='url(#gemFacet)'/>

    <!-- Pavilion right facet -->
    <polygon points='76,40 74,52 50,50 50,88 80,56' fill='#6dd0f8'/>

    <!-- Center front facet -->
    <polygon points='26,52 50,50 74,52 50,88' fill='url(#gemLeft)'/>

    <!-- Girdle shine line -->
    <line x1='24' y1='40' x2='76' y2='40' stroke='#f0fcff' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.9'/>
    <line x1='26' y1='52' x2='74' y2='52' stroke='#f8ffff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Highlight sparkles on the gem -->
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='1.2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny outer sparkles -->
  <g fill='#dff6ff'>
    <circle cx='12' cy='30' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='34' r='1'/>
    <circle cx='16' cy='70' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='84' cy='72' r='0.9'/>
  </g>
</svg>
